auth.setupTitle: First run: set the login password
auth.setupHint: No length limit; the derivation is unsalted, so a long random string is recommended (safer over HTTPS).
auth.brandTagline: One binary · one SQLite · one pipeline
auth.loginHint: Enter the login password to obtain the admin key
auth.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match
auth.adminKeyHint: Store it now. It is derived from the login password, so changing the password changes this key.
auth.howToRecompute: How to recompute: admin key = Base64(SHA256(login password)).
auth.backoff: Too many attempts, please retry later

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.abnormalScanLimited: Only the first {count} lanes were scanned
dashboard.noFailures: No failed requests in this range

lanes.title: Lanes
lanes.listHint: Explicit lanes are an optional override layer: create one only when you need a custom order, renamed members, or to pool different upstream model names. Most models route through implicit chains from channel declarations.
lanes.memberRequired: At least one member is required
lanes.memberChannelRequired: Every member must select a channel
lanes.upstreamModelHint: Leave empty to send the lane name as the upstream model.
lanes.name: Name
lanes.affinityHint: 0 = no stickiness (default). Set it only when you need to damp flapping.
lanes.overridesHint: Leave empty to inherit the lane config.
lanes.dragHint: Drag to reorder; order is written back as priority.
lanes.deleteConfirm: Delete lane "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
lanes.emptyGuide: No lanes yet. Create one, or rely on implicit routing from channel model declarations.

channels.title: Channels
channels.name: Name
channels.modelsHint: One per line, or comma separated. Declaring a model makes it routable immediately.
channels.keyHint: Write-only: after saving only the prefix is shown.
channels.emptyGuide: No channels yet. Add one to make its models routable.
channels.deleteConfirm: Delete channel "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
channels.priorityHint: Higher numbers are preferred when routing.
channels.paramOverrideHint: Leave empty for no override; must be valid JSON.
channels.statsEmpty: No requests recorded for this channel in the stats window.

models.title: Model routes
models.chainHint: The order requests will actually be attempted in.
models.emptyGuide: No routable models yet. Declare models on a channel and they appear here.
models.selectHint: Pick a model on the left to see which upstreams it hits, and in what order.

logs.title: Request logs
logs.emptyGuide: No logs match the current filters.
logs.emptyGuideNoFilter: No request logs yet. Records appear here once the model API is called.
logs.timeHint: Entered in local time; converted to RFC3339 on submit.
logs.noAttempts: This record has no attempt details.

keys.title: Client keys
keys.name: Name
keys.ipAllowlistHint: Empty = no restriction. One entry per line; CIDR supported.
keys.rotateConfirm: Rotate key "{name}"? The old key stops working immediately.
keys.deleteConfirm: Delete key "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
keys.plainOnceHint: Copy it now; it will never be shown again.
keys.emptyGuide: No client keys yet. Create one to call the model API.
keys.noLanes: Lane list not loaded (or no lanes yet). You can fill it in later.
keys.allowLanesHint: Only the checked lanes are usable; everything else is denied.
keys.denyLanesHint: The deny list is layered on top of the allow set and wins.
keys.createDone: Key "{name}" created; the plaintext is shown only once
keys.rotateDone: Key "{name}" rotated; the old plaintext is dead

playground.title: Playground
playground.thinkingHint: These two must be set as a pair; setting only one returns HTTP 400 from the upstream.
playground.clientKeyHint: The Playground calls the model API, so it needs a client key (not the admin key).
playground.clientKeyRequired: Enter a client key first (not the admin key).
playground.messagesRequired: Enter at least one non-empty message.
playground.laneHint: The list comes from /models; the request's model field is this value.
playground.emptyGuide: No routable models yet. Declare models on the Channels page first.
playground.badRequestHint: HTTP 400: the usual cause is setting only one thinking parameter — enable_thinking and reasoning_effort must be set as a pair.

settings.title: Settings
settings.accountHint: Changing the login password also changes the derived admin key.
settings.passwordChanged: Password updated; the admin key changed
settings.howToRecompute: How to recompute: admin key = Base64(SHA256(login password)); after a password change, re-derive it and update any caller credentials.
settings.apiKeyLocalHint: This key lives only in this browser's local storage; copying it hands over full admin access.
settings.importInvalid: This file is not a valid config bundle; nothing was imported.
settings.pricingHint: Unit: CNY per million tokens. Leave a price blank (or 0) to skip that dimension; a model missing from this table is not converted at all. The table only feeds cost conversion in logs and stats — accounting only, never billing: it does not affect admission and never debits quota.
settings.pricingSaveHint: Only changed rows need saving; saving replaces the whole table, so removing every row clears it.
settings.pricingEmpty: No model unit prices configured yet. Add a row and fill in prices to convert the cost column in logs.
settings.invalidPrice: Price must be a valid number: {model}
settings.pruneConfirm: Delete log entries older than the retention window?
settings.autoEnableHint: Default is ON — the opposite of the old system. When off, auto-disable is one-way and members silently disappear from lanes.
settings.keywordsHint: One per line; matched against upstream error messages.
settings.defaultLaneConfigHint: The six keys are lane-level settings, edited per lane on the lane editor page; these are only defaults and global options never change them.
